# smart-base-block-kinds

The `dak` adapter's block kinds, one folio-block-kind/v1 node per file: kind, builder, label prefix and RDF types. Read by schemas/dak-kinds.ts and dak-jsonld.ts; loadContributions registers them for a folio only when its dependency tree includes smart-base.

Part of [SMART Base](../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `smart-base-block-kinds`, holding `block-kinds`.
